integrations_researched.name: Pillow (PIL)

api_patterns.verified_against: Installed package verification + existing codebase usage in ico_converter.py

gotchas: ICO format requires square dimensions for each size
Must convert to RGBA mode for transparency support
Source image must be at least as large as the largest icon size requested

integrations_researched.name: Tkinter

verified_package.name: tkinter
verified_package.install_command: No installation needed - part of Python standard library

gotchas: Native drag and drop not supported in standard Tkinter
Requires tkinterdnd2 extension for drag and drop functionality
tkinterdnd2 may require separate installation on some platforms
Limited styling options compared to modern frameworks
macOS requires additional setup for tkinterdnd2

integrations_researched.name: tkinterdnd2

api_patterns.verified_against: tkinterdnd2 documentation and community usage patterns

gotchas: Requires TkinterDnD.Tk() instead of tk.Tk() for root window
Drop event data contains file paths with curly braces on Windows
Platform-specific behavior differences (Windows vs Linux vs macOS)
Must call drop_target_register() before dnd_bind()
On macOS, may require tcl/tk extensions to be properly installed

integrations_researched.name: PyQt5

imports: from PyQt5.QtWidgets import QApplication, QMainWindow, QLabel, QVBoxLayout, QWidget

gotchas: Larger dependency (~100MB+)
Requires QApplication instance (only one per process)
Must handle event overrides properly
More complex API than Tkinter
GPL license (commercial license available)
Windows may require additional Visual C++ runtime

integrations_researched.name: PySide6

imports: from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication, QMainWindow, QLabel, QVBoxLayout, QWidget

gotchas: Larger dependency (~100MB+)
Requires QApplication instance (only one per process)
Must handle event overrides properly
More complex API than Tkinter
LGPL license (more permissive than PyQt5)
Official Qt for Python binding (recommended by Qt Company)
Windows may require additional Visual C++ runtime

unverified_claims.claim: tkinterdnd2 works seamlessly on all platforms
unverified_claims.reason: Platform-specific setup may be required, especially on macOS. Not verified through testing.

unverified_claims.claim: PyQt5/PySide6 drag and drop is more robust than tkinterdnd2
unverified_claims.reason: Comparative analysis not performed. Both have different trade-offs.

recommendations: For a simple GUI wrapper with drag-and-drop, recommend starting with Tkinter + tkinterdnd2 due to minimal dependencies and built-in availability
If a more professional appearance and advanced features are needed, consider PySide6 (LGPL license, official Qt binding)
Pillow is already verified and working in the codebase - no changes needed
Consider implementing both Tkinter and Qt options to allow user choice, or start with Tkinter for MVP
Test drag-and-drop functionality on all target platforms (Windows, Linux, macOS) as behavior varies
Handle file path parsing carefully for drag-and-drop events (especially curly braces on Windows with tkinterdnd2)

tkinter.best_for: Simple tools, quick prototypes, minimal dependencies

PyQt5/PySide6.best_for: Professional applications, complex UIs, polished user experience
